g.text: Regularization helps the larger cohorts; classical accuracy remains ahead
Eight diagnostic parents · same 5 × 5 periodic finite-difference grid · physical response RMS, lower is better
RMS aggregates equal-parent mean squared error. Projection is an offline diagnostic, not a selected deployable result.
Reference uncertainty is empirical, not certified. Reused development observations provide no confidence interval or new speedup claim.
